title: polypodium loriforme var. heterolepis
intro: Polypodium loriforme var. heterolepis, commonly known as Polypodium heterophyllum, is a type of fern plant that belongs to the Polypodiaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its purported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include wound healing, anti-arthritic effects, and the treatment of various skin conditions. Polypodium loriforme var. heterolepis contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
